commitNote: The harness, loadtest/competitors/ and MicroProxy at this commit, run through loadtest/competitors/dedicated/bootstrap.sh (RUN=1, JDK=25). The memory scenario was run again on a machine of the same shape with the harness and MicroProxy at 471ba13, which add MicroProxy's request head timeout (and its wait for a head's next bytes without a buffer) and give every proxy the same head timeout (--head-timeout 70, the idle timeout, so none fires during the 40 s attacks); its runs (memoryFrom) give every memory-under-attack figure. The raw results of the first campaign are on the perf/gcp-20261016 branch, those of the memory runs on perf/slowloris-20261018.
